threads.body: Dropping falsey finish reasons makes this array lose its positional correspondence with `response.generations`. For example, `stop`, missing, `length` becomes `['stop', 'length']`, so `length` is attributed to the wrong candidate. The linked semantic convention requires one value per returned generation and recommends `error` when an expected reason is absent; preserve the slot instead of filtering it.
